text: 会议指出，人口是经济社会发展的基础条件，要更好统筹人口与经济社会、资源环境的关系，进一步完善相关政策，持续积累和释放人口综合红利，以人口高质量发展更好支撑经济社会高质量发展。要更加突出人的全面发展，提高人口科学文化、职业技能、身心健康等水平，加快完善全民终身学习机制，广泛开展技能培训，强化教育、培训与产业发展协同联动，促进高质量充分就业。
text_en: The meeting noted that population is the foundational condition for economic and social development. It is necessary to better coordinate the relationship between population and economic and social development as well as resources and the environment, further improve relevant policies, continuously accumulate and unleash the comprehensive demographic dividend, and better support high-quality economic and social development with high-quality population development. Greater emphasis should be placed on people's all-round development, raising the population's levels of scientific and cultural knowledge, vocational skills, and physical and mental health, accelerating the improvement of a lifelong learning mechanism for all, widely carrying out skills training, strengthening coordinated linkages among education, training and industrial development, and promoting high-quality full employment.
